title: Autonomous Coding Production Readiness Roadmap
goal: Move the autonomous coding foundation from proven backend pieces to a reliable workstation-first project-runner workflow that can be monitored and controlled remotely through Telegram.

relationship_to_existing_roadmaps.this_track_focus: Production orchestration, resumability, project scope, MCP workbench verification, remote status/control and deployment gates.
relationship_to_existing_roadmaps.telegram_role: Remote monitor and control channel, not the primary development workspace.

implemented_foundation: routes/coding_agent_routes.py exposes task-plan, quality-gate, worktree-quality-gate, sandbox-checks, done-gate, patch-set, publish-plan and subagents-plan endpoints.
src/coding_agent_backend.py already provides task plans, worktree creation gates, patch-set application gates, quality/done gates, publish plans and subagent contracts.
src/coding_agent_sandbox_bridge.py and tests/test_coding_agent_sandbox_bridge.py provide a sandbox check bridge and redacted evidence path.
src/server_project_runner.py provides repo-only universal project runner planning with deploy/Cloudflare gates that do not execute live actions.
plugins/telegram/plugin.py already records redacted task pause/resume/cancel/status control events in the agent task ledger.
src/tool_capability_maintenance.py and related tests cover post-update capability knowledge refresh foundations.
src/coding_project_scope.py resolves repo/project references into bounded allowed_paths, checks, branch policy and sandbox policy with ambiguous-name blocking.
src/coding_agent_sandbox_bridge.py now emits redacted evidence bundles and src/coding_agent_runner_state.py consumes sandbox dispatch results into review_ready or blocked runner phases.
src/agent_task_ledger.py exposes metadata-only coding-agent control events and src/coding_agent_runner_state.py consumes pause/resume/cancel events without starting unrestricted execution.
src/coding_agent_backend.py and src/server_project_runner.py expose explicit operator_gate and evidence_summary metadata for commit, push, deploy and Cloudflare handoff plans.
src/tool_capability_knowledge.py and src/tool_capability_refresh.py build safe autonomous-coding capability knowledge and Memory/RaptorGraph write intents.

src/agent_sandbox_worker.py and ops/homeserver/run-sandbox-job.py now support a narrow homeserver SSH host-runner backend for Podman sandbox jobs without exposing generic host shell, Docker, or Podman socket access.
Debian live evidence on commit eb43519d proves host_ssh sandbox terminal execution and a scoped rw mount write with network none, no secrets and redacted durable evidence.
missing_or_not_yet_durable: Real deploy/Cloudflare exposure remains gated until explicit operator Go.

The implemented ACPR-0 through ACPR-9 foundation is not yet bound for readiness conformance to the CAO-owned canonical Planning-first coding lifecycle/controller and graph boundary, independently owned agent-review closure, executable UI receipts, a bounded repair/escalation loop, or role-capsule isolation and parent/child handoff verification.
recommended_sequence: CAO-08A and CAO-08B lifecycle/controller and graph-boundary contracts accepted
CAO-08D and CAO-08E execution-plane contracts accepted
CAO-08B1 and CAO-08C1 subagent context/delegation contracts accepted
CAO-08G and CAO-08H review/writeback lifecycle contracts accepted

current_frontier.status: ACPR-10 is accepted; ACPR-11 remains blocked until CAO-08A and CAO-08B contracts are accepted, so no ACPR-11 through ACPR-16 implementation slice is currently claimable.
blocked_by: CAO-08A and CAO-08B accepted lifecycle/controller and graph-boundary contracts
current_frontier.next_after_acceptance: CAO-08A and CAO-08B acceptance, then ACPR-11 readiness binding/conformance
current_frontier.later_bundle_constraints: ACPR-17 is deliberately later: it requires accepted CAO-08B1/C1 subagent contracts and ACPR readiness prerequisites, then supplies VCL-7 before CAO-08G can consume readiness lanes.

cross_roadmap_ownership.shared_non_duplication_rule: No track may create another Planning authority, claim authority, gate truth or memory truth. Planning remains canonical, CAO owns the lifecycle/controller, ACPR supplies readiness evidence, Harbor One projects read-only state and user decisions, and RAPTOR/GraphRAG remains advisory only.
bundle_order: CAO-08C, CAO-08D and CAO-08E accepted execution-plane contracts
ACPR-12 through ACPR-15 accepted readiness lanes
CAO-08B1 and CAO-08C1 accepted subagent context/delegation contracts
ACPR-17 accepted VCL-7 role-capsule and handoff readiness lane
CAO-08F may complete from its CAO contracts without consuming ACPR lanes; CAO-08G and CAO-08H may then consume the accepted ACPR lanes including VCL-7
ACPR-16 consumes accepted CAO-08G and CAO-08H review/writeback lifecycle contracts
cross_roadmap_ownership.anti_cycle_rule: CAO may reference ACPR VCL/readiness lanes only after the applicable ACPR readiness slices are accepted; ACPR consumes CAO contracts only at the explicit dependency points below and never creates a controller replacement. In particular, ACPR-17 consumes accepted CAO-08B1/C1 contracts before CAO-08G consumes VCL-7.

canonical_planning_authority.rule: A validated Planning item is the sole authority for slice identity, dependency order, allowed paths, acceptance, gate requirements and current status.
canonical_planning_authority.rejection_rule: Chat memory, agent summaries, retrieved graph context, a prior receipt or a task prompt cannot widen, replace or close the Planning item. Missing, stale or ambiguous Planning data blocks the slice.

raptor_graphrag_checkpoints.purpose: Retrieve bounded candidate context and prior evidence references for the exact Planning item.
raptor_graphrag_checkpoints.required_receipt: planning_item_id, canonical_plan_revision, memory_query_class, bounded_reference_ids, retrieval_status and raw_content_visible=false
raptor_graphrag_checkpoints.truth_boundary: Planning remains authoritative; a missing or conflicting memory result blocks for Planning clarification rather than changing scope.

raptor_graphrag_checkpoints.stage: after scope resolution and before an edit capsule
raptor_graphrag_checkpoints.purpose: Offer bounded code, test and dependency references within Planning-authorized paths.
raptor_graphrag_checkpoints.required_receipt: scope_digest, allowed_path_count, candidate_reference_ids, unresolved_reference_count and raw_content_visible=false
raptor_graphrag_checkpoints.truth_boundary: Retrieved references cannot authorize a path, tool, shell command, dependency or product decision.

raptor_graphrag_checkpoints.stage: after each failed deterministic verification or rejected patch and before repair planning
raptor_graphrag_checkpoints.purpose: Retrieve bounded failure, regression and prior-resolution references within the active Planning envelope so a repair plan can be evaluated without replaying raw logs.
raptor_graphrag_checkpoints.required_receipt: planning_item_id, canonical_plan_revision, active_planning_envelope_digest, revision_binding, dirty_diff_digest, failed_lane_receipt_ids, rejected_patch_digest_or_none, bounded_failure_reference_ids, retrieval_status and raw_content_visible=false
raptor_graphrag_checkpoints.truth_boundary: Failure retrieval never contains raw logs, source content or provider output; it cannot authorize, select or execute a repair, waive a failed lane, widen scope or determine acceptance.

raptor_graphrag_checkpoints.stage: only after all required machine_auto and independent agent_auto gates, plus any applicable user_acceptance gate, are closed
raptor_graphrag_checkpoints.purpose: Persist provenance-linked Code, Causal and Memory write intents for an already accepted Planning outcome and the next approved Planning item.
raptor_graphrag_checkpoints.allowed_effect: bounded post-acceptance write-intent persistence and handoff continuity only
raptor_graphrag_checkpoints.required_receipt: planning_item_id, canonical_plan_revision, revision_binding, required_machine_auto_receipt_ids, independent_agent_auto_receipt_id, applicable_user_acceptance_state, code_write_intent_id, causal_write_intent_id, memory_write_intent_id, provenance_reference_ids and raw_content_visible=false
raptor_graphrag_checkpoints.truth_boundary: Writeback is never evidence of acceptance and cannot mark a Planning item done, waive a gate, infer user acceptance or authorize commit, push, deploy or another live action.

coding_loop_authority_contract.memory_failure_rule: Unavailable, stale, conflicting or low-confidence RAPTOR/GraphRAG output is recorded as a bounded non-authoritative limit; the runner continues only when the canonical Planning item remains complete and unambiguous.

subagent_context_and_delegation_contract.authority_boundary: CAO owns the lifecycle/controller, dispatch and declared fanout/depth mechanics. ACPR verifies conformance through VCL-7 and does not create another controller, Planning authority, claim authority, gate truth or memory truth.

role_capsules.may_receive: validated Planning identity/revision, declared child role, bounded scope digest, capsule policy and child lifecycle metadata
role_capsules.must_not_receive_or_forward: raw private source, secrets, raw logs, undeclared foreign paths or authority to close child review/user gates

role_capsules.may_receive: fresh Planning-bound task capsule, exact allowed paths, declared tool budget, time/token budget, bounded advisory reference ids and exact-read requirements
role_capsules.must_not_receive_or_forward: parent private context not required by scope, reviewer authority, cross-scope/foreign-path data, secrets, raw logs or recursive delegation authority beyond its declared fanout/depth

role_capsules.may_receive: a reviewer-fresh retrieval capsule built from current Planning revision, current diff binding, exact source reads and verified code/test/lane evidence
role_capsules.must_not_receive_or_forward: a copied implementer context capsule or summary as its evidence source, implementer identity authority, secrets, raw private content or authority to close user_acceptance

role_capsules.may_receive: bounded query class, active Planning envelope digest and provenance requirements
role_capsules.must_not_receive_or_forward: execution authority, mutable claim/gate state, raw source/logs, secret/private content or permission to select a repair

subagent_context_and_delegation_contract.evidence_precedence: Current validated Planning, exact source reads and current code/test evidence win. RAPTOR/GraphRAG retrieval is advisory only and must be fresh, provenance-bound and scoped before use.

delegation_limits.identity_rule: parent identity, child identity, role, Planning item/revision, capsule id, dispatch nonce, lease/fence and current diff binding must be distinct and recorded in every handoff receipt
delegation_limits.fanout_depth_rule: A child may dispatch only when the parent Planning item declares the exact fanout and depth; duplicate child dispatch or recursion beyond those limits fails closed.
delegation_limits.lifecycle_rule: Cancellation, expiry and resume require the current lease/fence and Planning revision; a resumed child receives a fresh capsule rather than inheriting stale retrieved context.
delegation_limits.writeback_rule: No Code/Causal/Memory writeback is allowed before all applicable machine_auto, independent agent_auto and user_acceptance gates are closed; writeback remains a provenance-linked intent, never acceptance evidence.

machine_auto.purpose: Deterministic mechanical checks with an exact revision or dirty-diff binding.
machine_auto.may_close: The machine verifier may close only the named machine_auto check after every required receipt validates.
must_not_close: commit, push, deploy, provider write or any live action
minimum_evidence: canonical command or internal check identity
exact revision and dirty-diff digest before and after execution

agent_auto.purpose: Independent agent review of a bounded implementation and its machine receipts.
agent_auto.may_close: A designated independent reviewer agent, recorded with a distinct implementation identity, may close the named agent_auto review gate after Planning scope, diff, receipts, rollback state and escalation rules are checked.
must_not_close: material architecture, product or scope decisions
commit, push, deploy, destructive or external/live actions
minimum_evidence: review findings or explicit no-findings record
remaining limits and next gate owner

user_acceptance.purpose: Human product and risk authority; only the user may close this gate.
required_for: material product, architecture or scope decisions
commit, push, publish, deploy, provider write, host change, backup or restore
minimum_evidence: revision or artifact binding where applicable
rollback or recovery plan for an effectful action

gate_taxonomy.ambiguous_acceptance_rule: When acceptance is ambiguous, incomplete, stale or conflicting, no gate advances. The runner records waiting_on_user with the exact Planning field or decision needed.

eligible_only_when: the Planning item is complete and unambiguous
the proposed edit remains within allowed paths and declared acceptance
the safe shell/tool capsule allows the exact action
no auth, security, privacy, destructive, external or live risk is involved
the attempted repair can be reverted transactionally
required_each_attempt: new transactional worktree or clean rollback boundary
diff and receipt binding before verification
checkpoint_3 failure-retrieval receipt before repair planning
independent agent review after a passing repair

mandatory_escalation: ambiguous acceptance or incomplete Planning authority
scope expansion or an undeclared path/tool/dependency
overlapping foreign work or unresolved ownership
unavailable, conflicting or unbound verification evidence
repair_and_escalation_policy.escalation_result: Stop edits, preserve the current worktree, attach only redacted revision-bound receipts, and create a Planning-linked waiting_on_user or waiting_on_peer decision; no third automatic repair is attempted.

verification_lanes.purpose: Create an isolated worktree, bind the authorized diff, permit a reversible edit, obtain independent review and retain a rollback descriptor without touching foreign work.

closers.agent_auto: independent reviewer agent, never the implementer

deterministic_evidence: Planning revision and scope digest
base revision, worktree id and pre/post dirty-diff digests
changed-path subset result
rollback descriptor and rollback-readiness result
independent-review receipt id
verification_lanes.limits: A passing rollback-readiness check does not authorize discard, commit, push or external mutation.

verification_lanes.purpose: Run only explicitly allowlisted argv/tool calls in the sandbox with no host shell, default network, secrets or unbounded filesystem access.

closers.agent_auto: not applicable unless a repair follows

deterministic_evidence: capsule policy version and command/tool identity
scope digest, sandbox profile and bounded timeout
network/secrets/host-shell denied assertions
exit classification and redacted output digest
exact revision and dirty-diff binding
verification_lanes.limits: A denied action escalates; the capsule never falls back to arbitrary shell or another tool.

verification_lanes.purpose: Select focused tests from a reviewed path-to-test map, widen for shared contracts, then enforce lint, type and coverage ratchets without claiming complete coverage from a narrow lane.

closers.agent_auto: independent reviewer when a repair or scope-sensitive exception is proposed

deterministic_evidence: pre/post revision and dirty-diff digests
changed paths and explainable selected-test reasons
focused and required widened test receipts
lint and type diagnostic counts by stable rule id
coverage baseline, observed value and ratchet decision
verification_lanes.limits: Missing mapping, unavailable runtime or a ratchet exception fails closed to a broader declared lane or escalation.

verification_lanes.purpose: Execute hermetic Playwright UI flows, accessibility assertions and visual comparisons rather than accepting an unattested image file.
verification_lanes.gate_class: machine_auto plus user_acceptance for UI/UX acceptance
deterministic_evidence: revision and dirty-diff binding
browser/runtime version and hermetic fixture id
test, accessibility and visual-comparison results
bounded screenshot/trace hashes and viewport metadata
known visual limits and explicit user-acceptance state
verification_lanes.limits: A visual artifact proves availability only until the executable checks and any required user acceptance are recorded.

verification_lanes.purpose: Run a content-free, egress-denied agent evaluation and transform failures into bounded, deduplicated redacted intake records.

closers.agent_auto: independent reviewer agent for classification; never the failing implementer

deterministic_evidence: approved fixture and evaluator version ids
model, prompt, tool-budget and configuration fingerprints
egress-denied and allowed-root assertions
quality/latency/cost threshold results and exact revision binding
redacted normalized failure signature, deduplication key and ownership proposal
verification_lanes.limits: The intake record diagnoses neither root cause nor repair authority; raw prompts, source text, provider output and host paths are forbidden.

verification_lanes.purpose: Prove that passing implementation lanes advance only to independent review or user acceptance, while publication and live effects remain separate actions.

closers.agent_auto: independent reviewer agent, never the implementer
closers.user_acceptance: user only for every publication or live-effect authorization

deterministic_evidence: implementer/reviewer identity distinction
Planning status proposal rather than self-completion
all prerequisite lane receipt ids with exact revision binding
separate commit/push/publish/deploy/live-go decision state
remaining verification and recovery limits
verification_lanes.limits: No successful review implicitly authorizes staging, commit, push, publish, deploy, provider write or host action.

verification_lanes.purpose: Verify that CAO-declared subagent role capsules, parent/child dispatch and independent review remain Planning-bound, scope-confined, fresh, budgeted, cancellable and provenance-verifiable.
verification_lanes.gate_class: machine_auto then agent_auto; user_acceptance only when an applicable user-owned gate exists

closers.agent_auto: independent reviewer agent using a fresh reviewer retrieval capsule, never the implementer or parent controller
closers.user_acceptance: user only for any UI/UX, material product/architecture/scope, auth/security/privacy, destructive/external/live or publication decision

deterministic_evidence: current Planning item id, canonical revision, active envelope digest and exact allowed-path digest
parent/child identities, roles, capsule ids, dispatch nonce, lease/fence, declared fanout/depth and duplicate-dispatch result
retrieval freshness, provenance chain, advisory-memory status and exact source/code/test evidence references
current revision and dirty-diff binding for every child input and child result
token/time budget limits and observed bounded counters
allowlisted tools/sandbox profile plus denied network/unauthorized-tool assertions
cancellation, expiry and resume transition receipts with fresh-capsule proof
reviewer-fresh retrieval capsule id, reviewer identity distinctness and no implementer-context-copy assertion
applicable gate states and provenance-linked Code/Causal/Memory write-intent state
required_negative_cases: recursive delegation beyond declared fanout or depth
cancellation, expiry and resume without a fresh valid capsule
child result not bound to current diff
memory writeback before all applicable gates
verification_lanes.limits: RAPTOR/GraphRAG is advisory only. Current Planning plus exact source reads and current code/test/lane evidence win; no VCL-7 result creates a competing controller, Planning/claim/gate/memory truth, authorizes a repair or treats writeback as acceptance.

gate_queue.decision_needed: Approve a harmless workstation-created coding task and Telegram status/control smoke on Debian.
gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: Remote controls could affect the wrong task or start work without reviewed scope.

blocks: real deploy or Cloudflare tunnel publish
gate_queue.decision_needed: Approve exact target, branch, service and rollback plan for any deploy.
gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: Production state could change without operator review.

gate_queue.decision_needed: Install/enable corresponding MCP services in Codex/Odysseus when available, then run bounded smoke tests.
gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: The runner may rely on unverified MCP tools or overly broad control surfaces.

gate_queue.decision_needed: Resolved: root/Sol deep-reviewed the ACPR-10 roadmap diff, gate ownership, Planning authority, memory truth boundaries, repair limits, cross-roadmap ownership and verification contracts.
gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: Subsequent coding-loop implementation could inherit ambiguous authority, allow self-approval or silently broaden publication/live actions.

blocks: material product, architecture or scope decisions
authentication, security or privacy policy decisions
gate_queue.decision_needed: Only the user may close each specific acceptance request after receiving a bounded decision packet and applicable revision/artifact evidence.
gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: An agent could manufacture product or risk acceptance from tests, memory or review prose.

blocks: staging, commit, push, publish, deploy, provider write, host change, backup, restore and every destructive/external/live action
gate_queue.decision_needed: The user must grant a separate action-specific authorization with exact target, scope, rollback/recovery plan and post-action readback for each effectful action.
gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: A green local coding loop could be misread as authority to mutate repositories, providers, hosts or production.

blocks: repair after ambiguity, scope expansion, material decision, security/privacy risk or foreign-work overlap
gate_queue.decision_needed: After any mandatory escalation, preserve evidence and ask the independent reviewer or user for the exact next bounded decision; the implementer cannot clear this gate.
gate_queue.may_close: independent reviewer for a purely mechanical re-scope; user only when user_acceptance categories apply
gate_queue.user_acceptance_required_when: The escalation concerns UI/UX, material product/architecture/scope, authentication/security/privacy policy, destructive action or external/live action.
gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: The runner could loop on unbounded repairs or absorb foreign/risky work.

blocks: CAO-08G consumption of VCL-7 subagent readiness evidence
gate_queue.decision_needed: Accept CAO-08B1/C1 contracts and ACPR-11/12/13/15 prerequisites, then verify VCL-7's bounded role-capsule, parent/child handoff and independent-review evidence before downstream lifecycle consumption.
gate_queue.may_close: machine verifier for VCL-7 only, followed by an independent agent_auto reviewer; user only for any applicable user_acceptance category
gate_queue.risk_if_bypassed: A child could receive stale, over-broad or private context, evade budget/lease limits, self-review, recurse beyond declared authority or write memory before acceptance.

success_metrics: Coding tasks are started primarily from workstation/project-runner state.
Telegram can monitor and control active tasks without being the main workspace.
Runner state is durable and resumable after restart.
Commit, push and deploy are explicit gated phases.
Odysseus can refresh its tool/capability self-knowledge after updates.
Every coding edit binds a canonical Planning item and revision; RAPTOR/GraphRAG context is recorded at four checkpoints but never acts as truth or authorization.
Every machine_auto result has a deterministic exact revision/dirty-diff receipt, and every agent_auto closure records reviewer identity distinct from the implementer.
Diff-aware tests, lint, type and coverage ratchets fail closed or widen verification rather than claiming broad coverage from a narrow lane.
Executable Playwright, accessibility and visual receipts distinguish automated UI evidence from user-only UI/UX acceptance.
Offline agent evaluation and redacted failure intake preserve deterministic evidence while prohibiting raw private content and automatic root-cause repair.

Subagent parent/child handoffs use role-isolated, Planning-bound capsules with fresh provenance, bounded fanout/depth, lease/fence, budget, cancellation/resume and current-diff receipts; reviewers retrieve independently rather than copying implementer context.
No coding-loop outcome implicitly authorizes commit, push, publish, deploy or a destructive/external/live action.
